Name: EVENT_BGM_BOSSCHRID_CONVERT_PARAM_ST
Description: Boss BGM: matches a boss character to a sound state name and value when its music is requested.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 72 of 164 rows.

Fields.Name: BGM State Name
Fields.Description: Name of the sound state switched to when this boss's music is requested; must match one of the sound bank's state names. Retail: e.g. _CL_Bgm_RareMap_Volcano, _CL_Scenario_05_Power_R1, c4800.

Fields.Name: Boss BGM Value
Fields.Description: Value passed along when this boss's BGM state is requested. Its effect on the music is not established. Retail: 80-90 on a boss's main row, 24-70 on its other rows, 0 on the 10000000+ rows.
